name: SecureVault
tagline: A local-only, three-factor encrypted vault and system hardening toolkit - no cloud, ever.
description: SecureVault is a standalone privacy suite for Linux and Windows. It combines an offline AES-256-GCM encrypted file-and-password vault - unlocked by three factors (master password, a click-only randomized on-screen PIN pad, and a TOTP code) with a keylog-resistant design and an optional local-only browser autofill bridge. Alongside it ships a set of standalone PowerShell scripts that harden Windows: encrypted DNS, inbound firewall lockdown, idle-footprint reduction, Chrome hardening and more, each with a matching revert. Nothing talks to the cloud; the only secret is what you type.
aiStack: Python (tkinter GUI, cryptography), PowerShell 5.1+, Chrome MV3 extension, native messaging host
